source.sampleClaim: Original first-hand commenter neoslayyer reports prospecting 35 R3 Draconium Ore and receiving 2 R2 Illimited Diamonds; says 20 Enterprising and 30 Prospecting points. Comment publication and actual cast dates unavailable.
source.sourceLineOrComment: Comment by neoslayyer, Retail item 192869; rank 2 diamond corresponds to item 192870; the comment does not include actual per-cast logs.

outputs.note: Historically reported 2 R2 diamonds from gross 35 R3 ore; no verified actual cast denominator. This independently corroborates R3 input -> R2 output eligibility in historical conditions, NOT a 2026 rate, nor two distinct hit operations.

notes: The same author reports 150 R2 Draconium -> 2 R2 diamonds, 1000 R2 Serevite -> 2 R2 and 2 R3 diamonds, and 100 Khaz'gorite -> 2 R2; these are context only, not assigned worker claims. Same Wowhead comment mirrored across locales is ONE original source.
